Most SEO guides assume you have a domain authority of 30+, a backlink profile, or a budget for links. I had none of those.

What I did have: 165 markdown blog posts, a freshly built site, and the stubborn belief that good content gets indexed eventually.

Here is the exact playbook. No paid tools, no shady link schemes.

- Brand new domain (3 months old at the time)
- Next.js + Cloudflare Pages
- 6 languages via next-intl
- 109 free browser-based tools (the actual product)
- 165 blog posts translated into 6 languages (~990 pages total)
- Zero backlinks (I was starting from scratch)
- Zero marketing budget

articles.excerpt: We’ve started working with AI like a colleague, not just using it as a tool. We ask it to plan work, coordinate people, surface risks, and tell us what should happen next. But an AI colleague with tha…
articles.body: We’ve started working with AI like a colleague, not just using it as a tool. We ask it to plan work, coordinate people, surface risks, and tell us what should happen next. But an AI colleague with that much responsibility needs more than intelligence. It needs professional discipline. That is why I made Project Manager PMBOK 7 principles-aligned through documented tailoring : so an AI PM can operate with autonomy without confusing confidence for evidence—or rigor for bureaucracy. This is not a claim of PMI certification. It is a concrete design decision about how the system decides which management disciplines apply, which do not, and how those decisions stay honest.

articles.excerpt: Flutter Platform Channels: Calling Kotlin from Dart Flutter gives you a single codebase for Android and iOS, but sometimes you need functionality that is specific to the native platform. This is where…
articles.body: Flutter Platform Channels: Calling Kotlin from Dart Flutter gives you a single codebase for Android and iOS, but sometimes you need functionality that is specific to the native platform. This is where Platform Channels become useful. In this tutorial, we will build a simple Flutter-to-Kotlin bridge using MethodChannel . What are Platform Channels? A platform channel allows Dart code to communicate with native Android or iOS code. Flutter / Dart | | MethodChannel v Android / Kotlin | v Native API Flutter provides: MethodChannel — request/response calls EventChannel — continuous streams of events BasicMessageChannel — asynchronous messages For calling a Kotlin function and receiving a result, MethodChannel is usually the best choice.

articles.title: What Is Technical Documentation, and What Should It Include?
articles.excerpt: Originally published at https://ninadpathak.com/articles/what-is-technical-documentation-and-what-should-it-include/. Technical documentation is the material that helps someone understand, use, integr…
articles.body: Originally published at https://ninadpathak.com/articles/what-is-technical-documentation-and-what-should-it-include/ . Technical documentation is the material that helps someone understand, use, integrate with, or safely operate a system. It works when a reader can take the next step without guessing. Think of it as a route through a product. A tutorial gets someone moving, reference answers an exact question, explanation gives a decision context, and troubleshooting helps when the route breaks. What technical documentation should include Start with the reader task, not a list of page types. A developer evaluating a product needs different information from someone sending a first API request or investigating an error.

articles.title: 1-billion-year-old Mars meteorite found in Algeria is like nothing we've seen from the Red Planet
articles.excerpt: Scientists found a Martian meteorite on Earth that is finally filling in a nearly 2-billion-year-old geology-history gap on the Red Planet.
articles.body: A newly found Mars meteorite is revealing the secrets of a previously hidden time period of Red Planet geological history. The 1.27-billion-year-old space rock, called Northwest Africa (NWA) 13441, was discovered in Algeria in 2019 — but its age was not confirmed until recently. Now scientists say the meteorite helps answer questions about a huge gap in the Martian geologic record: a span of time between 600 million years ago and 2.4 billion years ago. This vast timespan has no known examples of meteorites containing igneous (solid magma) shergottites, which are the most abundant type of Martian meteorites , chunks of the Red Planet that were blasted away by impacts, ejected into space and eventually fell to Earth .

articles.title: SpaceX launches 29 Starlink satellites to orbit from Florida (video, photos)
articles.excerpt: SpaceX launched 29 more of its Starlink internet satellites to orbit from Florida's Space Coast today (Aug. 11).
articles.body: SpaceX sent yet another batch of its Starlink internet satellites skyward today (Aug. 11). A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Florida's Cape Canaveral Space Force Station today at 11:58 a.m. EDT (1558 GMT), carrying 29 of the broadband spacecraft toward low Earth orbit (LEO). About 8.5 minutes later, the rocket's first stage made a pinpoint landing in the Atlantic Ocean atop the SpaceX droneship "A Shortfall of Gravitas." It was the 18th flight for this particular booster, which is designated B1085. The Falcon 9's first stage is seen just after its drone-ship landing on Aug. 11, 2026. (Image credit: SpaceX) Though more than half its liftoffs have been Starlink flights, B1085 also has some astronaut missions under its belt.

articles.title: NASA will chase the Aug. 12 total solar eclipse with balloons and a high-altitude jet
articles.excerpt: "Scientists can study the sun's corona in a way we can't from anywhere else in the solar system."
articles.body: A total solar eclipse isn't just a spectacular sight to witness for those lucky enough to lie in the path of totality (or travel to it, as many dedicated skywatchers do). It also gives scientists a rare chance to study the sun's outer atmosphere, or corona, during the day. As such, NASA plans to take full advantage of the opportunity for the upcoming total solar eclipse happening on Aug 12. The space agency's WB-57 high-altitude research jet will chase the moon's shadow across the globe, which will extend the agency's ability to capture data from the eclipse. The NASA-supported Nationwide Eclipse Ballooning Project will also coordinate teams to release balloons that will help us know how our atmosphere changes when an eclipse turns the sky dark during the day.
